explanation.correct: The Zurich release includes CMDB Workspace V7.6 with updates and improvements for configuration management. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/upgrades-and-patching-events/live-on-servicenow-discover-new-features-and-learn-about-the/ev-p/3416998

questions.question: What Zurich feature provides access to external data sources like Snowflake and BigQuery without copying data to ServiceNow?

explanation.correct: Workflow Data Fabric Hub provides Zero Copy Connectors to access external data from ERP systems, Snowflake, BigQuery, and data lakes without storing it in ServiceNow. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/workflow-data-fabric-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Data Import Sets import data into ServiceNow; Workflow Data Fabric accesses it without copying.
CMDB Data Sync is not the name of this Zurich feature.
External Data Tables is not the correct name for this capability.

references: Zurich Release Notes - Workflow Data Fabric

source.excerpt: Zero Copy Connectors: Access external data without storing it in ServiceNow.

questions.question: What is the correct triage order when troubleshooting duplicate CIs in CMDB Health?

options.text: Data Sources → Certification Rules → Identification Rules → Reconciliation
Identification Rules → Reconciliation → Data Sources → Certification Rules
Reconciliation → Identification Rules → Certification Rules → Data Sources
Certification Rules → Data Sources → Reconciliation → Identification Rules

explanation.correct: The correct triage order is: 1) Identification Rules, 2) Reconciliation, 3) Data Sources, 4) Certification Rules. This ensures you check CI matching logic first before validating data quality. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-servicenow-platform/page/product/configuration-management/concept/csdm-cmdb-foundations-dashboards.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Starting with Data Sources skips critical identification and reconciliation checks.
Reconciliation should come after Identification Rules, not before.
Certification Rules are the last step, not first.

source.excerpt: Triage order: Identification Rules → Reconciliation → Data Sources → Certification Rules.
